items.claim: A `{ px }` stroke under a one-axis stretch is too thick in one direction
items.note: The stroke is now drawn in the stroke's metric (a frame where lengths measure as on screen). That covers native strokes, outlined strokes, marker heads, and natively stroked text, which keeps its text matrix so the glyphs don't move. I added an optional `spaces` argument to `markerDrawCommands` in renderer, with its own `minor` `api` changeset. I also removed the README's "uses the mean scale" approximation.

items.claim: Opacity outside 0..1 is written to `/ca` and `/CA` as given
items.note: The value is clamped in `extGState`, so every caller writes the same valid value.

items.claim: A text command dropped for a non-finite number still sets the document's `/Lang`
items.note: `writeOne` now takes back the languages a rolled-back command added.

items.claim: An isolated group's color matrix is applied to each child, not to the whole group
items.note: When the matrix reads or changes alpha and a `rasterize` hook is given, the group is rasterized. Without a hook it is still applied per child and reported in `skipped`; that replaces the old alpha-offset-only skip, and the README says so.

items.claim: Language tags are compared case-sensitively in one place and not in the other
items.note: `writePages` now compares lowercased tags and writes the first spelling.

items.claim: A source rect reaching past the bitmap leaves that part blank
items.note: `place` fills the part past each edge from the half pixel at that edge, which repeats the edge pixels. Images and sprites both go through it.

items.claim: A paint's opacity is applied after the group color matrix instead of before
items.note: This covers solid paints, including strokes and text, and gradient stops. Texture fills and images were left alone: I checked the renderer, and it applies their opacity after the matrix (`patternFill`, and the image quad's `a_post`), so the PDF already matched.

items.claim: Non-finite opacity drew an image, sprites, an isolated group or a raster fully opaque
items.note: The same `< 1` check sat in `writeShadedFill` for gradients and is fixed in the same commit, so these are now dropped and reported the way a path is.

items.claim: Texture pattern memo keyed only on the texture id
Solid stroke on a path with no commands wrote `S` with no current path
One non-finite text in a `text-layer` dropped the whole layer
Once a face runs out of spare codes, a glyph's next reading silently reused its first reading's code
items.note: This was my call: such a glyph now has no code and is drawn as an outline. It is recorded in `docs/unruled.md`.
